title: Hung-file and serve-output trials pass on a busy host
description: Run both regressions with four CPU burners per available core (96 on a 24-core host). The hung file must fail by name while the finishing file passes; both serve failures must keep all output and remove read-only scratch. Burners are stopped when the tests finish, including failures.

steps.name: trial timing regressions with every core saturated
